user.title: Home Thermal Lab
user.description: Pick the outdoor temperature sensor used by the shadow controller and the contribution chart. Add the sensors afterwards from the integration's page.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Home Thermal Lab is already set up.

user.title: Shadow zone
user.description: Says whether a heating call starting now could be skipped (hypothesis 17). Nothing is switched.

data_description.room_entity: Used instead of the thermostat's own reading when set.
data_description.tolerance: How far below the setpoint the room may drift.
data_description.max_dip: Skip a heating call only if the room stays within this of the setpoint.
data_description.walls: Faces with windows that let the sun in.
data_description.roofs: Face and pitch in degrees, comma separated, for example: S 30, W 30.
data_description.rotation: Degrees the house is turned from true north (see scripts/house_orientation.py).
data_description.shade_below: Treat the south-east to south-west sun as blocked below this elevation (trees, neighbours).

user.title: Furnace energy
user.description: A modelled energy meter (kWh) for the energy dashboard, from the furnace state and a power for each state.

data_description.climate_entities: Every zone's thermostat; the furnace state is read from all of them.
data_description.fan: Leave a state blank for zero.

user.title: Contribution chart
user.description: Splits one zone's temperature into what moved it, past and forecast.

data_description.other_climate_entities: Their heat calls feed the crossover term.
data_description.plug_entities: Their power is turned into heat.
data_description.lights: Light entity and watts at full brightness, for example: light.office_main_lights=105.
data_description.walls: Faces with windows that let the sun in.
data_description.roofs: Face and pitch in degrees, comma separated, for example: S 30, W 30.
data_description.rotation: Degrees the house is turned from true north (see scripts/house_orientation.py).
